why: Source: spot that the pie is a share of one segment, sum three slices and scale by the segment, rescale two other claims, reject the unsupported transfer claim (about 5 steps); question: the same base trap, sum-and-scale and rejections (about 5 steps).

Source: manual and machine per-kg and set-up costs, lifetime cost to yearly to daily, break-even inequality, smallest option above (about 7 steps); question: the same conversions with a four-year life and 245 days (about 7 steps).
Source: two awareness rates from the table and their difference (3 steps); question: the same two divisions and difference (3 steps).

Source: sum the last three waterfall bars and one share of it, sum four middle bars and share of total, two threshold checks (about 6 steps); question: the same group sums, shares and two thresholds (about 6 steps).
Source: combined total, gridline reads of two bars, four weighted-share or bounding checks (about 5-6 steps); question: identical structure on two hospitals with a 90% threshold (about 5-6 steps).

Source: read revenue and market size for two years off an unlabelled dual-axis chart, two shares, difference, divide by three years (about 7 steps); question: the same four dual-axis reads, two shares, difference and annualisation (about 7 steps).
Source: four per-unit divisions or two equal-denominator pairings plus one cross-check, rank (about 3-5 steps); question: the same pairing structure and ranking (about 3-5 steps).
Source: sum all members, uniform uplift total, subtract from estimate, weighted sum with 2x multiplier, solve x, double (6 steps); question: the same sequence (6 steps).

Source: multiply main-reason share by hotel share, reject spending claim, rescale day-trip share, reject main-vs-only (4 checks); question: the same four checks with the same nested-share trap (4 checks).
Source: sum 12 labelled bars and top-two share, two per-head ratio comparisons, no-cost-data check (about 5 steps); question: the same four statement types on twin 12-bar charts (about 5 steps).
